title: Earth, Moon & Sun: Day & Night
welcome_lead: Why does the sky go dark? Earth spins, and we ride along.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: rotation, day/night, time zones.
final_note: One spin of Earth is one day — and it's faster than you think.

walkthroughs.body_html: Earth turns on its axis. The side facing the Sun is in daylight; the opposite side is in night. The Sun isn't moving — we are.
A full rotation takes about 24 hours. That's why a day is 24 hours long. Different places see the Sun at different times.
Earth is split into time zones so each region sets clocks to suit its own daylight. The UK is on GMT/BST.
